title: No Request Left Behind: Tackling Heterogeneity in Long-Context LLM Inference with Medha
technique: preemptive fine-grained scheduling (LARS), adaptive chunking, stream pipeline parallel, KV-cache parallelism

optimized_metrics.evidence: The scheduler must assign each request to time slots on available GPUs to maximize goodput - the fraction of requests meeting their deadlines
This budget, derived from decode requests' TPOT SLOs, ensures prefill operations cannot delay latency-sensitive decode tokens.
The batch packer constructs batches that maximize throughput while respecting a strict iteration time budget

headline_claim.text: Under a heterogeneous workload, Medha improves throughput by 5.7x while reducing median and 99th-percentile latency by 30x and 174x, respectively, compared to state-of-the-art non-preemptive systems.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: This phase is compute-bound, with performance measured by Time-to-First-Token (TTFT).
metric_definitions.notes: Prefill latency; in the convoy experiments clearly includes queueing behind long requests.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Its performance is measured by Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT) or Time-Between-Tokens (TBT) [4].
metric_definitions.notes: TPOT and TBT used as synonyms, no formula.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: maximize goodput - the fraction of requests meeting their deadlines
metric_definitions.notes: Defined as a fraction of requests, not a rate.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Our capacity evaluation focuses on two key metrics: TTFT and TPOT, as these directly impact user experience in interactive scenarios.
metric_definitions.notes: 'Capacity' = QPS sustainable at acceptable TTFT/TPOT; no numeric threshold stated in text read.

slo_spec: Per-request deadlines (relative slack LARS); TPOT SLO sets per-iteration time budget t_target (example 20 ms); decode of ~250 ms/iter called an order of magnitude above typical production SLOs
tradeoff_acknowledged: Explicit throughput-latency trade-off of chunking (large chunks -> throughput, small chunks -> decode latency) and TTFT-vs-TPOT trade-off of KVP; Medha 3D has slightly lower peak throughput than 2D.
workloads: ShareGPT4 + 5% long requests; coding-issue traces with 393K-839K prefill
